Callout.Name: Man with a Gun
Callout.Message: Man seen with a firearm at a bus stop.
Callout.Advisory: No shots fired, handgun in his waistband.

Script.Line: It is in my waistband because I am allowed to carry it.
I have got a permit. It is at the house.
Nobody has been threatened. Ask anybody here.

Lines.Approach: Caller says it is in his waistband. No shots yet.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
